items.body:
## Problem Support ticket previews in the Concierge chat do not show that the ticket thread has replies. Customers can't tell that a conversation with their support rep is happening inside the ticket, so they keep typing in the main Concierge chat instead. ## Example 1. A customer created a support ticket and got good help from a support rep. 2. The customer started following the rep's instructions. 3. The customer opened Concierge in the RHP and saw the support ticket preview. 4. The customer typed in the main Concierge chat, thinking they were replying to the rep. This started a new thread with Concierge instead. 5. Concierge replied, and the customer got frustrated. There is currently no indicator on the support ticket preview that the support rep has responded. ## Solution Show the thread replies (reply count, like regular threads) below the support ticket preview, so customers know there is a conversation in the ticket and can open it. This should reuse the existing thread-reply UI pattern. cc @jasperhuangg _Reported in [Slack](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/C090U774ZH7/p1792196359542379)._

items.body:
Coming from [this Slack thread](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/C07HPDRELLD/p1780877229183859), we want to display the current balance and remaining limit for third-party company card programs connected via Plaid, mirroring the existing pattern on the Expensify Card page. ### Background The Expensify Card page already shows current balance, remaining limit, and cash back at the top of the card table. Third-party company card feeds show no equivalent data today, even when the feed is connected via Plaid and balance data is available. Several users have asked for balance tracking in Expensify, and this is a natural starting point for the company card case. ### Details #### Data source - Use the Plaid [`/accounts/get`](https://plaid.com/docs/api/accounts/#accountsget) API to retrieve current balance and remaining credit limit for Plaid-connected company card programs. - Note: Plaid [confirmed](https://expensify.slack.com/archives/CCQJP89RV/p1781117797778729) this specific Plaid endpoint is free, so there should be no added cost to us. - Thinking we could attempt to refresh this data each time we scrape an assigned card for new transactions, since we're already hitting the connection at that point. Store the timestamp of the last successful fetch on our end. Maybe we also update it separately once a day, too (in case there are no assigned cards). - The balance will not update in real time. It will be whenever Plaid fetches new data from their bank connections (1-4 times per day). - Note: balance data will not available from Plaid for all card issuers/networks. - Balance info availability for our native bank connections is an open question. As such, we'll start with Plaid only for this issue. We should investigate whether balance data is available for our other bank connections as well and treat that as a follow-up, if so. Displaying this for personal cards is out of scope for now. #### Display - We'll show a balance block above the card table on the Company cards page, similar to the pattern of the Expensify Card page (current balance + remaining limit). - We'll reuse the pattern of having tooltips for both `Current balance` and `Remaining limit`. - `Current balance` proposed tooltip copy: - **Current balance** - Current balance is reported by your bank and last updated [date/time]. - `Remaining limit` proposed tooltip copy: - **Remaining limit** - Remaining limit is reported by your bank and last updated [date/time]. - The timestamps in the tooltips will use the same format as card updated (e.g. `Last updated: 2026-06-09 20:05:01`), so admins understand the data may not be real-time. - Here's how I'm thinking we handle varying scenarios of this balance info being available: - Non-Plaid feed → hide the balance block entirely for now. - Plaid connected, but issuer does not provide any balance data → hide the balance block entirely - Plaid connected, partial data returned → show the block with "Not available" for whichever field is unavailable. - Plaid connected, full data returned → show current balance and remaining limit. - Note: the mockup below assumes the bulk actions changes are done. Those are being handled separately in https://github.com/Expensify/App/issues/93334 and are out of scope here. This issue is just focused on current balance and remaining limit. ### Proposed balance block ### Existing tooltip pattern with Expensify Cards
